Claim 1 (Currently amended): A gas generator comprising: a composition containing an alkali metal chlorate as an oxidizer provided at about 25-75 weight percent, and a carboxylic acid as a fuel provided at about 25-75 weight percent, said percentages stated by weight of the total composition; and a desiccant in operable communication with said composition, wherein said desiccant is present in an amount that increases the thermal stability of said composition.

Claim 2 (Currently amended): The gas generator of claim 1 wherein said desiccant is mixed into said composition at about 10-35 weight percent of the total composition, thereby improving the thermal stability of the composition.

Claim 3 (Currently amended): The gas generator of claim 1 wherein said desiccant is in vapor communication with, but physically separated from, said composition, and said desiccant is provided in amounts resulting in a mass differential of about -5.0 to 5.0% of the composition after heat aging at 107°C for 400 hours, contributing to the thermal stability of the composition.

Claim 4 (Currently amended): The gas generator of claim 1 wherein said composition contains an extrusion aid provided at about 0.1-10 weight percent of the total gas generant composition, said extrusion aid contributing to the thermal stability of the composition during processing.

Claim 6 (Currently amended): The gas generator of claim 1 wherein said alkali metal chlorate is potassium chlorate, and said composition is formulated to enhance thermal stability.

Claim 7 (Currently amended): The gas generator of claim 1 wherein said carboxylic acid is selected from tartaric acid and its isomers, succinic acid, glutamic acid, adipic acid, and mucic acid, and mixtures thereof, said selection contributing to the thermal stability of the composition.

Claim 8 (Currently amended): The gas generator of claim 1 wherein said carboxylic acid is DL-tartaric acid, said selection being optimized for thermal stability in the composition.

Claim 13 (Currently amended): A composition comprising: an alkali metal chlorate as an oxidizer provided at about 25-75 weight percent; a carboxylic acid as a fuel provided at about 25-75 weight percent; and a desiccant provided at about 5-35 weight percent, said percentages stated by weight of the total gas generant composition, wherein said desiccant is selected to enhance thermal stability of the composition. 

Claim 14 (Currently amended): The composition of claim 13 wherein said carboxylic acid is selected from tartaric acid and its isomers, DL-tartaric acid, succinic acid, glutamic acid, adipic acid, and mucic acid, and mixtures thereof, thus contributing to the thermal stability of the composition.

Claim 15 (Currently amended): The composition of claim 13 wherein said alkali metal chlorate is potassium chlorate, optimized for thermal stability.

Claim 16 (Currently amended): The composition of claim 13 wherein said desiccant is selected from activated calcium sulfate, silica, zeolite, clay, and calcium oxide, thereby improving thermal stability.

Claim 18 (Currently amended): The composition of claim 13 wherein said desiccant is selected to provide a mass differential of about -5.0% to 5.0% after heat aging at 107°C for 400 hours, thus enhancing the thermal stability of the composition.
